date_note: Date is the Asharq Al-Awsat article's first publication day (24 November, relaying a New York Times report); the page gives no earlier day.
title: Report: CIA and ODNI hit by cyber intrusion into open-source intelligence system, officials say no classified data exposed
org: Central Intelligence Agency and Office of the Director of National Intelligence
summary: Asharq Al-Awsat, citing US media, reports that the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence were hit by a cyber intrusion that exposed some unclassified information. The New York Times reportedly said it targeted a system used to analyse open-source intelligence, and US officials told it no classified information was exposed. An ODNI official said the breach did not disrupt any core capabilities; the CIA declined to comment.
plain: Asharq Al-Awsat, citing the New York Times, says the CIA and ODNI suffered an intrusion into an open-source intelligence system. Officials reportedly say no classified information was exposed.
exec: Per the report, officials say only unclassified information was exposed and no core capabilities were disrupted.

validation.note: Only Asharq Al-Awsat was read; it relays a New York Times report and unnamed US officials. The Times original was not read and no official page was found.
